title: Giving Martin 1 Extra Queen Every Game Until I LOSE
summary: Reverse odds: Tony (White) gives Martin one extra queen in game 1 and one more each game until Martin wins. Extra black queens appear on Black's side (first one on h6). Tony wins games with 1-6 extra queens; Martin finally wins with 7 extra queens.
rules: Standard armies plus N extra black queens for Martin.
Game 1: 1 extra queen (placed on h6); add one more extra queen each game Tony wins.
Tony plays White; challenge ends when Martin wins.
win_condition: Player must keep winning; mode ends when the bot wins (record: Martin needed 7 queens).
